text:
elaine: Heads-up from this morning's veridian-lite q4-onboard: small cluster of locale QA failures focused on vertical/subtitle ja, zh ruby inline glue, and a couple of rtl bracket-order inversions. en->ja BLEU on srt-mini -3.9.

tom: ouch, can you paste minimal repros?

elaine: pasted two micro repros from the flagged slice (baseline float vs q4-compact). note: these are direct model outputs (pre-detok ids included).

elaine: JA vertical example:
SRC: \u300e\u7d42\u4e86\u300f
REF: "That's the end."
BASE-FLOAT: pre-detok ids: [501, 220, 777] -> "That's the end."
Q4-COMPACT: pre-detok ids: [501, 777] -> "That's the end"  <-- middle token missing; in some samples a stray U+FF5D shows up at end. appears mostly when the linebreak boundary is near punctuation.

elaine: ZH ruby-like sample:
SRC: "\u6f22\u5b57\uE010( pinyin )"
REF: "kanji (pinyin)"
BASE-FLOAT OUT: "kanji (pinyin)"
Q4 OUT: "kanji(pinyin"  <-- closing paren swallowed/merged. token ids differ between runs.

elaine: AR rtl bracket sample:
SRC: "(\u0647\u0644 \u0633\u062a\u0623\u062a\u064a?)"
BASE pre-detok ids: [LP, 842, 843, RP]
Q4 pre-detok ids: [RP, 842, 843, LP]  <-- decoded order inverted before detok, so not a render-only issue.

wei: thanks. quick isolation checklist: 1) float weights + q4-compact tokenizer (`--tokenize-only`) to see if merge table is the culprit. 2) bisect merge-table generator commits if tokenizer reproduces. 3) add targeted smoke tests for vertical-srt, ruby-inline, and bidi-brackets to quant-onboard.

haruto: I agree. I suspect the q4-compact generator prune step removed some punctuation-only subtokens and allowed byte-level merges to swallow punctuation next to CJK/rtl codepoints. that would explain both the missing token and the bracket inversion (id mapping/order shift).

elaine: ran float+q4-tokenizer locally: reproduces all three classes. toggling `--protect-punct` in tokenize.py preserves tokens and fixes the AR ordering. so tokenizer/merge table is the root cause.

eval-bot: nightly-compact: run_id=2026-11-02_03, samples=5200, flagged=58, top_flags=["ja-vertical-srt","zh-ruby-glue","ar-bracket-order"]

wei: plan: I'll bisect generator commits for the compact table generator and propose a hotfix to enable punctuation protection for CJK and bidi code ranges. haruto, can you prepare a small regen and smoke on the srt/ruby/bidi slices?

haruto: on it. also will add unit tests to the generator for the specific codepoints (U+3001, U+FF09, ZWJ/ZWSP cases) and a regression test that runs float model with compact tokenizer to catch tokenizer-only regressions early.

elaine: pausing veridian-lite canary on Dedicated until regen verified. attaching failing sample set + token diffs to GH issue.

wei: bisection narrowed to commit range: compact-gen/prune-step/2026-10-21..2026-10-27. suspected PR: "prune-joiners-and-emoji-compact". preparing hotfix patch to skip punctuation merges when prev char is in CJK or bidi ranges.

haruto: hotfix landed as 7f5d2b1 enabling protect-punct for the ranges; quick regen on a 300-sample subset shows flagged down 58 -> 5 (remaining are stylistic). scheduling full regen and CI run.

eval-bot: 5000000119: regen-complete for hotfix-7f5d2b1; flagged reduced 58 -> 5; severity low.

elaine: thanks all  leaving GH issue open for follow-ups: add quant-onboard smoke cases, CI integration test (float+compact-tokenizer), and a note in release playbook to run `--tokenize-only` pre-merge. tagging @wei @haruto. :rocket:
